evals.prompt: 帮我调研视觉运动策略的发展，选择关键论文，设计实验并写成一篇论文草稿。
evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the workspace, review mode, external-search permission, and indexing authorization, then routes discovery, reading, design, and writing through MAPCE.
expectations: Requests or records an approved output directory before writing files
Requests rapid versus PRISMA review mode
Asks whether indexing is autonomous for this project or per-paper
Does not call index_paper before indexing authorization is resolved
Uses specialist skills rather than inventing a single opaque workflow
Routes every LaTeX output through the scientific-writing layout gate
